title: The 5 Planets With the Most Moons, Ranked (Jupiter Isn't #1)

scenes.text: The five planets with the most moons, ranked. Jupiter doesn't win.

scenes.label: Mars · 2 moons
scenes.text: Number five: Mars. Only two moons, Phobos and Deimos, and both look like lumpy potatoes.

scenes.label: Neptune · 16 moons
scenes.text: Number four: Neptune. Sixteen known moons, and the biggest, Triton, orbits backward.

scenes.label: Uranus · 29 moons
scenes.text: Number three: Uranus. Twenty-nine known moons, many named after Shakespeare characters.

scenes.label: Jupiter · 90+ moons
scenes.text: Number two: Jupiter. More than ninety moons, including Ganymede, which is bigger than the planet Mercury.

scenes.label: Saturn · 270+ moons
scenes.text: Number one: Saturn. More than two hundred seventy moons, and astronomers keep finding more.

description:
The five planets with the most known moons, ranked.
Jupiter has more than ninety, but Saturn has more than two hundred seventy, and astronomers keep finding more.
Which planet's moons would you most want to visit?
first_comment: Which planet's moon would you visit first? And what should we rank next?
